evidence: Bassett_FY2022: p5 statement prints 18,400 on the 'Intergovernmental' row in the 'CDBG Fund' column; p24 'CDBG FUND' schedule prints 'Grant' 18,400 under 'Intergovernmental' / 'State sources'. The fund name is a federal programme (CDBG), which by the 2026-11-19 ruling identifies federal grants; the page also prints the sub-heading 'State sources' (CDBG passed through the State), which would point to intergovernmental/state aid. The two printed indications conflict; I followed the fund-name ruling.
